title: Selected historical public aggregates for the Suntory case study
scope: Historical descriptive evidence; no current-market or causal claim

outlets.metric: Highball handling outlets as described in Suntory's retrospective account
outlets.limitation: Company retrospective; no independent outlet audit or precise 2009 cutoff supplied; not a measure of incremental profit

strong_zero.metric: Sales volume relative to previous year
strong_zero.limitation: Company-reported brand aggregate; not revenue or profit; not the isolated effect of DRY
